contract.rps_denominator: successful completions / elapsed including final drain
contract.ring_route_gate: Each node must show exact submitted and completed B1-query deltas equal to 16 warmup requests plus successful timed queries; zero ring fallback and HNSW search calls.
contract.scope_limit: Only B1/C64 and B1/C128 across four metadata categories, AVX-512 VNNI and Auto. Prior a1 Veortex and historical native rows are references only; neither is measured again.

ring_admission_proof.counter_semantics: Process-global per-node ring counters increment once for each B1 query submitted/completed; measured-row delta includes 16 warmup requests plus timed requests and final drain.
